title: VPN client troubleshooting (macOS)
content: If Tunnelblick stuck at 'connecting': remove old profiles in ~/Library/Application Support/Tunnelblick/Configurations; re-import .ovpn.

title: VPN client troubleshooting (macOS)
content: Tunnelblick connecting loop: delete profiles in Tunnelblick/Configurations; ensure DNS set to 10.8.0.1; re-import latest .ovpn from IT portal.

title: Customer: HelioMart tax settings
content: HelioMart uses Avalara in US only. For EU orders: set tax_mode=manual and apply VAT via Shopify; do not send EU transactions to Avalara.

title: PostgreSQL maintenance window
content: Prod DB vacuum: Sundays 02:00-03:00 UTC. Autovac tuned: autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor=0.05 for orders table.

title: PostgreSQL maintenance window
content: Prod DB vacuum: Sundays 02:00-03:00 UTC. Orders table scale_factor=0.03; analyze_scale_factor=0.02. Watch bloat via pgstattuple weekly.

title: Kubernetes: canary rollout checklist
content: Use Argo Rollouts: set analysis step w/ Prometheus query for 5xx rate < 1%. Pin maxSurge=1, maxUnavailable=0 for api deployments.

title: Kubernetes: canary rollout checklist
content: Argo Rollouts canary: analysis w/ Prometheus 5xx <1% and p95<400ms; maxSurge=1 maxUnavailable=0; pause 5m between steps; auto-abort on error budget burn.

title: Go module proxy workaround
content: For private modules: set GOPRIVATE=github.com/redwoodlabs/* and GONOSUMDB same; use SSH URLs; cache misses fixed by 'GOPROXY=direct'.

title: Go module proxy workaround
content: Private modules: GOPRIVATE=github.com/redwoodlabs/*; set GIT_SSH_COMMAND to use ed25519 key; use GOPROXY=direct in CI to avoid sum.golang.org lookups.

title: Interview loop: backend criteria

title: Redis: cache key conventions
content: Prefix with app + env: billing:prod:invoice:{id}. Use TTLs: 5m for list endpoints, 1h for invoices. Avoid wildcard deletes; use version suffixes.

title: Security: rotating GitHub tokens
content: Use GitHub fine-grained PATs; store in 1Password vault 'Engineering Secrets'; rotate quarterly; disable classic PATs; audit via org settings > Token policies.

title: Security: rotating GitHub tokens
content: Prefer GitHub App tokens over PATs. If PAT needed: fine-grained, least privilege, store in 1Password 'Engineering Secrets', rotate every 90 days.

title: Book notes: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
